newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BGZ BANK UPS DEPOSIT AND CREDIT RATES.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BGZ BANK UPS DEPOSIT AND CREDIT RATES.

text.p: Poland's state-owned Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej SA (BGZ) increased its deposit and credit rates by about one percentage point on average on August 13, the farming bank said in a statement.
BGZ's raised call deposit rates from 12 to 13 percent, three-month deposits from 18 to 19 percent, six-month deposits from 19 to 20 percent and one-year deposits from 20 to 20.5.

One-year consumer credits, until now at 27 percent or higher, were raised to 28.5 percent to higher. One-year credits for firms were upped to 27 percent from the previous 26.5 while one year credit for car purchases rose to 27 percent from 25.

BGZ's rate increases follow the National Bank of Poland's official interest rate rise on August 4. The NBP increased its lombard rate by two points to 27 percent and discount rate by 2.5 to 24.5 percent.
